complete

One-sentence summary: Inkuno's current branding is a placeholder two-cards glyph plus green/orange ad-hoc icons and theme accents, wired through one in-app SVG asset, OS launcher files, and docs/site art — all replaceable file-by-file from the Inkuno brand kit without touching app logic.

Key findings (path:line):
- In-app logo is code-drawn, not a file: `src/ui/assets.rs:595-602` `logo()` tints `"logo.svg"` arm (`src/ui/assets.rs:229-232`, two rounded rects) with `t.accent.opacity(0.85)`; sole caller is the rail commands button `src/shell/sidebar.rs:1188-1195` (`rail-logo`, asserted in `src/shell/tests/window.rs:317-318`); About footer reuses it `src/shell/help.rs:~590-640` (`logo(t)` + `"Inkuno {version}"` + GitHub/Ko-fi links).
- Window identity: `src/shell/mod.rs:~360-410` `run()` sets `TitlebarOptions{title:"Inkuno"}` and `app_id:"com.inkuno.Inkuno"` for both capture and main windows; Linux draws client-side bar (`src/shell/render.rs:1-60`, `SHADOW/PILL_ROOM/STRIP`), macOS/Windows use native chrome. No `set_window_icon`/dock-icon GPUI call exists — launcher icon comes only from OS packaging.
- Linux launcher: `com.inkuno.Inkuno.desktop:9` `Icon=com.inkuno.Inkuno`, installed from root `com.inkuno.Inkuno.svg:1-16` (old dark-green/orange cards mark) via `Makefile:8-13`; `inkuno.metainfo.xml:1-20` has no `<icon>`/branding tags (relies on desktop-id match).
- macOS bundle: `packaging/macos/Info.plist:6-9` (`CFBundleName/DisplayName Inkuno`, `CFBundleIconFile Inkuno`) + binary `packaging/macos/Inkuno.icns` (old art) copied by `scripts/bundle-macos.sh:16-23` into `Inkuno.app`, ad-hoc signed; `src/platform/update.rs:~100-180` swaps `Inkuno.app` from the dmg and uses asset name `inkuno-macos.dmg`.
- Windows: `inkuno.ico` sits at repo root unreferenced (no code/workflow hit); `RELEASING.md:144-152` + `scripts/publish-release.py:20-30` confirm Windows installer/zip and Arch package were dropped from the pipeline — expected assets are only `inkuno-macos.dmg` + `inkuno-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` (`scripts/publish-release.py:14-30`, `.github/workflows/release-native.yml`, `.github/workflows/release-binaries.yml:33-95`); `book/src/updates.md:9-15` and `src/platform/update.rs:~180-220` only self-update macOS dmg + Arch pacman, Windows/Linux-source get a download link.
- Crate/build metadata: `Cargo.toml:1-9` (`name inkuno`, generic description, correct repository); `build.rs:1-7` is an intentional no-op (Linux icons install from sources, macOS from `packaging/macos`); no `[package.metadata]` icons, no winres/Windows manifest wiring.
- Color mismatch: site CSS `docs/index.html:17-24` uses accents `#b4532a`/`#e0926b`; built-in themes `src/ui/theme.rs:131-165` use `Inkuno Dark accent 0xe0926b`, `Inkuno Light accent 0x5f48b0` — neither equals brand `#4263EB`; backgrounds `#1b1a19`/`#fbfaf8` are near but not exactly brand `#171A22`/`#F5F5F2`, ink `#26231f` vs `#20232B`.
- Docs/site art (all old mark): favicon `docs/index.html:11` + header `docs/index.html:161` + footer `docs/index.html:301` use `docs/Inkuno.svg` (duplicate of root svg); `og:image docs/index.html:10` → `docs/site/inkuno.png`; `README.md:9,32-39` screenshots `docs/screenshots/inkuno.png` + `demo.gif`; `book/book.toml:13` `site-url /inkuno/guide/`, guide `book/src/introduction.md:1-10` and `book/src/img/*.svg` carry no logo (architecture diagram is content, not brand).
- Legacy seams to be aware of, not branding work: `src/platform/vault.rs:46-60,582-590` migrates `bref/`→`inkuno/` config and `.bref-icons`; workflows/RELEASING note remaining hardcoded `bref` strings belong to the rename crew.

How pieces connect: GPUI `Assets: AssetSource` embeds only UI glyphs (16px strokes); the product mark exists in exactly one runtime place (rail `logo()`) and three launcher places (Linux svg, macOS icns, orphan Windows ico), with release automation (`release.sh`, `release-native.yml` → `release-binaries.yml` → `bundle-macos.sh`/`Makefile`, gate `publish-release.py`) shipping only macOS+Linux — so a rebrand touches `assets.rs` + one file per OS + docs/site art + theme seeds, and must decide the Windows/Arch question explicitly.

Per-platform mapping table (platform/surface → brand-kit source → repo destination → current code ref):
- Linux launcher (hicolor scalable) → kit rounded app variant, full-detail SVG (transparent-bleed version if provided; else `app-light`/`app-dark` per theme) → root `com.inkuno.Inkuno.svg` (installed by `Makefile:11` to `.../hicolor/scalable/apps/`) → current `com.inkuno.Inkuno.svg:1-16` + `com.inkuno.Inkuno.desktop:9` + `src/shell/mod.rs:app_id`. Derivative goes in a separate build dir per kit README; do not edit SVG masters.
- Linux metainfo → kit `png/` (e.g. 128px) if store needs uploaded art → `inkuno.metainfo.xml` (add `<icon type="cached">`/`<branding>` only if targeting AppStream stores) → current file has no icon node.
- macOS launcher → kit `macos/Inkuno.iconset/` (rounded app variant, all required sizes, generated outside repo into build dir) → `packaging/macos/Inkuno.icns` → consumed by `scripts/bundle-macos.sh:19`, declared in `packaging/macos/Info.plist:9`, verified in `release-binaries.yml:47-55`. No plist rename needed.
- Windows launcher/installer → kit `windows/inkuno.ico` → new `packaging/windows/inkuno.ico` (or replace root `inkuno.ico` and wire it; currently orphaned) + new installer manifest (Inno/WiX config does not exist — pipeline dropped Windows) → no current code ref; `src/platform/update.rs` `asset_name()` returns `None` on Windows.
- In-app rail toolbar (16px) → kit `svg/` optical **16 simplified transparent mark** → `src/ui/assets.rs` `"logo.svg"` arm (`:229-232`) rendered by `logo()` (`:595-602`) at `px(15)` in `src/shell/sidebar.rs:1190` → replace path data with kit 16px master; per kit rule use exact palette (`#F5F5F2` on dark / `#20232B` on light or kit-specified toolbar color), which means removing the `t.accent.opacity(0.85)` tint — needs a brand decision.
- In-app About footer → kit lowercase `wordmark` (+ small mark) → `src/shell/help.rs` `render_help` about row → replace `logo(t)` + text `"Inkuno {version}"` with mark+wordmark assets; add new `AssetSource` arms (e.g. `wordmark.svg`) alongside `logo.svg`.
- Window title/taskbar text → already compliant lowercase `Inkuno` → `src/shell/mod.rs` `TitlebarOptions title` + `app_id com.inkuno.Inkuno`; no change except keeping the name.
- Theme accents → kit palette `#20232B/#4263EB/#F5F5F2/#171A22` → `src/ui/theme.rs:THEMES` Inkuno Dark/Light seed arrays + `docs/index.html` CSS `:root` → current seeds `0xe0926b/0x5f48b0` must be re-seeded to `#4263EB` (check contrast rules in `theme.rs` `of()`/WCAG fixups) and site CSS `--accent` updated.
- Favicon + site header/footer → kit `svg/` optical **24/32 simplified transparent mark** → `docs/Inkuno.svg` (and root `com.inkuno.Inkuno.svg` is a different surface — do not share) referenced by `docs/index.html:11,161,301` with `.brand img 24px` CSS.
- Social/screenshots → kit `png/` + wordmark lockup → `docs/site/inkuno.png`, `docs/screenshots/inkuno.png`, `demo.gif` (regenerate screenshots after theme change), `og:image` line `docs/index.html:10`.
- Crate metadata → no kit file → `Cargo.toml:1-9` description already generic; keep `name inkuno`; optional: add `repository`/homepage consistency only.

Gaps/blockers:
1. Brand-kit zip at `/Users/sachinkoli/Downloads/inkuno-brand-kit.zip` was not opened (no unzip/list tool in this read-only session) — kit-relative source paths above follow the brief's inventory (`svg/` 16/24/32 simplified + 48–512 full detail, `app-light/app-dark/app-blue`, wordmark, `png/`, `windows/inkuno.ico`, `macos/Inkuno.iconset/`); confirm exact filenames before editing.
2. Windows has no packaging target: reviving it means creating `packaging/windows/` installer config + wiring the ICO + adding the asset back to `publish-release.py:expected_assets` and a workflow job — or explicitly scoping Windows out (today's pipeline ships macOS+Linux only).
3. Conflict to resolve: kit "keep nib+ink mark as-is, transparent mark for toolbar" vs current `logo()` accent-tint — recommend untinted kit colors for rail/About and reserve `#4263EB` for theme accent/selection.
4. Optical-size rule needs a second in-app size only if the mark is reused larger (About/footer at ~15px can share the 16px master; favicon/header at 24px must use the 24px master, not a scaled 16).
5. `Cargo.lock` fragility (`ARCHITECTURE.md` rules, GPUI 0.2.2 pin): prefer no new dependencies (e.g. winres) — do ICO/ICNS generation with kit-provided files + system tools (`iconutil`, `hdiutil` already in use).

Files read: `ARCHITECTURE.md`, `Cargo.toml`, `build.rs`, `Makefile`, `README.md`, `RELEASING.md`, `com.inkuno.Inkuno.desktop`, `com.inkuno.Inkuno.svg`, `inkuno.metainfo.xml`, `packaging/macos/Info.plist`, `scripts/bundle-macos.sh`, `scripts/release.sh`, `scripts/publish-release.py`, `.github/workflows/release-native.yml`, `.github/workflows/release-binaries.yml`, `src/main.rs`, `src/shell/mod.rs`, `src/shell/sidebar.rs` (rail), `src/shell/help.rs` (about), `src/shell/render.rs` (chrome), `src/ui/assets.rs`, `src/ui/theme.rs` (seeds), `src/platform/update.rs`, `book/book.toml`, `book/src/introduction.md`, `book/src/img/`, `docs/index.html`, `docs/Inkuno.svg`, `docs/site/`, `docs/screenshots/`, `docs/design/`, `assets/fonts/`.
